That’s a concrete resiliency concern introduced by the diff: callers (many calendar/video token refresh paths were changed to use this wrapper) will wait on this network call as long as it takes. The finding’s broader claim about "indefinitely" blocking is somewhat overstated because platform/request-level timeouts aren’t shown in the diff, but the absence of an in-code timeout is verifiable.
